summary.text: POLARIS DISTRIBUSJON MIDT-NORGE AS is a private limited company registered in Heimdal, founded 2001-02-08. POLARIS DISTRIBUSJON MIDT-NORGE AS is registered as providing courier services (delivery of newspapers) and has the statutory purpose of distribution operations and related activities. It was previously named ADRESSA DISTRIBUSJON AS until 2019-02-04. Its main industry code is 53.200: other postal and courier activities. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 142 601 000 NOK and the annual result was -2 827 000 NOK; operating income was down from 144 920 000 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 1 143 000 NOK in 2024 to -2 827 000 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 8 770 000 NOK in 2024 to 10 469 000 NOK in 2025. The registered employee count went from 60 on 2025-11-13 to 50 on 2026-09-15.
